ดึงข้อมูล OHLCV (200 แท่ง)

parameters.pythonCode:
import pandas as pd
import talib
import numpy as np

# รับข้อมูลจาก node ก่อนหน้า
data = [item['json'] for item in _items]
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

close  = df['close'].astype(float).values
high   = df['high'].astype(float).values
low    = df['low'].astype(float).values
volume = df['volume'].astype(float).values

# === EMA ===
ema20 = talib.EMA(close, timeperiod=20)
ema50 = talib.EMA(close, timeperiod=50)

# === RSI ===
rsi = talib.RSI(close, timeperiod=14)

# === MACD ===
macd, macd_signal, macd_hist = talib.MACD(close, fastperiod=12, slowperiod=26, signalperiod=9)

# === Bollinger Bands ===
bb_upper, bb_middle, bb_lower = talib.BBANDS(close, timeperiod=20, nbdevup=2, nbdevdn=2, matype=0)

# === Volume SMA (20) ===
vol_sma20 = talib.SMA(volume, timeperiod=20)

# === ATR ===
atr = talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=14)

last = df.iloc[-1]
prev = df.iloc[-2]

vol_ratio = float(volume[-1]) / float(vol_sma20[-1]) if vol_sma20[-1] > 0 else 1.0

macd_cross = "NONE"
if macd[-2] < macd_signal[-2] and macd[-1] > macd_signal[-1]:
    macd_cross = "GOLDEN_CROSS"
elif macd[-2] > macd_signal[-2] and macd[-1] < macd_signal[-1]:
    macd_cross = "DEAD_CROSS"

bb_position = "MIDDLE"
if close[-1] > bb_upper[-1]:
    bb_position = "ABOVE_UPPER"
elif close[-1] < bb_lower[-1]:
    bb_position = "BELOW_LOWER"
elif close[-1] > bb_middle[-1]:
    bb_position = "UPPER_HALF"
else:
    bb_position = "LOWER_HALF"

return [{
    "json": {
        "symbol": "BNB/USDT",
        "timeframe": "1d",
        "price": round(float(last['close']), 4),
        "open": round(float(last['open']), 4),
        "high": round(float(last['high']), 4),
        "low": round(float(last['low']), 4),
        "volume": round(float(last['volume']), 2),
        "ema20": round(float(ema20[-1]), 4),
        "ema50": round(float(ema50[-1]), 4),
        "rsi": round(float(rsi[-1]), 2),
        "macd": round(float(macd[-1]), 4),
        "macd_signal": round(float(macd_signal[-1]), 4),
        "macd_hist": round(float(macd_hist[-1]), 4),
        "macd_cross": macd_cross,
        "bb_upper": round(float(bb_upper[-1]), 4),
        "bb_middle": round(float(bb_middle[-1]), 4),
        "bb_lower": round(float(bb_lower[-1]), 4),
        "bb_position": bb_position,
        "atr": round(float(atr[-1]), 4),
        "volume_ratio": round(vol_ratio, 2),
        "prev_close": round(float(prev['close']), 4)
    }
}]
